question:
**Direction: In the following question, out of the given four alternatives. Select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom / Phase.**

To fly into a rage
solution:
The correct answer is** "To get very angry."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"to fly into a rage" **means to suddenly become very angry. (अचानक बहुत क्रोधित हो जाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *I asked to speak to her boss and she just **flew into a rage**__.*
 
 
 
• The phrase** "fly into"** implies a quick or sudden action.
 
• **"Rage"** refers to intense anger or fury. (किसी बात पर बहुत क्रोध करना (विशेषतः चिल्‍लाते हुए))
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
